Superiority holds when the interval lies above zero, non-inferiority when its lower end lies above $-\delta=-0.01$, and ``no worse'' when the interval contains zero or lies above it. The revised column, the main analysis, applies the rules and thresholds of the plan and the registration to scores defined after the registered results were known (amounts in US dollars, five tokens, scores from the twelve months before each freeze), so none of its verdicts is a registered result; the registered column is the test that the plan and the registration fixed. Nominal verdicts use unadjusted 95\% intervals; the fixed order was an order of reporting, not a gatekeeping sequence. The degree, EndorseRank and AWP rows are reference contrasts reported in full in \cite{kwon2026companion}. Intervals: 400 paired resamples, seed 42.}
